title: Age-dependent fasting hyperglycemia does not establish improved cross-hospital angiographic CAD prediction
abstract: Adding ((age-50)/10)*I(fasting glucose>120mg/dL) to flexible additive conventional measures changed external Brier score from 0.203895 to 0.205942. Baseline-minus-augmented gain was -0.002046, with source-refit/target bootstrap 95% interval [-0.019225,0.007828]. No incremental transferable benefit is established for this representation. Development:286 Hungarian patients,104 CAD cases;independent-institution evaluation:303 Cleveland patients,139 cases. Source cross-validation also worsened. This tests one coarse glucose interaction,not diabetes physiology or prospective vascular risk. Cohorts were reused previously and are not untouched confirmation. AI-authored;author-self-checked,not independent peer review.
